The '''Bonadan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]] and [[Roonadan]], which orbited the [[Bonadan (star)|star Bonadan]].<ref name="TEA" />
